excerpt: DZero is one of two detectors positioned along the four-mile Tevatron accelerator ring. It takes its name from its location on the ring, D0. ... The 5,500-ton detector sits more than four stories tall. ... On March 2, 1995, physicists at CDF and DZero announced the discovery of the top quark.
